deployments_detail.use: AI Stock Talk chatbot (built with Bridgewise) providing gen-AI stock ratings and financial report analysis of thousands of companies
deployments_detail.value: first such tool in Israeli banking

deployments_detail.use: "Didi" in-app AI digital financial assistant that analyzes customer transactions to proactively deliver personalized insights, spending trends, savings opportunities and low-balance warnings; Hebrew NLP chatbot. Powered by Personetics (Cognitive Banking Brain / predictive analytics) with Nanorep for Hebrew natural-language understanding. [Personetics; Nanorep]
deployments_detail.value: 220,000+ active customers within 2 months of full rollout; 81% rated interactions highly; 30 pre-built insights

deployments_detail.use: "Smart Save" automated savings product using Personetics AI models and predictive analytics to identify spare funds in a customer's account and automatically transfer them to savings without overdrafting; sends progress notifications and nudges. Described as the bank's first Auto-Savings product. [Personetics]

"AI Stock Talk" generative-AI investment chatbot letting retail customers converse in Hebrew about ~40,000 supported stocks, get financial-report analysis, stock ratings and buy/sell-style guidance in the bank's app. Cleared by the Israeli securities regulator. Built on Bridgewise's Gen AI (a data-mining LLM, a stock-rating model, and a conversational LLM). [Bridgewise]
deployments_detail.value: Beta launch to 500 customers before full rollout; supports ~40,000 stocks

deployments_detail.use: "Smart Future" pension-planning digital platform/bot in the bank's app: consolidates pension and insurance data (via Israel's Pension Clearing House), runs a retirement-income simulator, and issues personalized alerts on high management fees, coverage gaps and outdated beneficiaries. Presented in the Q4 2025 earnings call as a first-of-its-kind pension planning bot alongside the bank's AI initiatives. [none]

Bank-wide AI and advanced-automation efficiency program: the CEO states processes that previously depended on substantial manpower are becoming automated and more precise, making a number of roles/positions redundant as part of accelerated digitization and AI. General program; no specific system named. [none]
Adi AI banking assistant answering customer queries (account opening, branch hours) without waiting for a human banker

"Adi" (עדי) voice-based AI banker on the bank's telephone service line (*6111), available 24/7. Customers speak questions naturally (no phone menus) and get answers on account balances, credit cards, deposits, loans, debit authorizations and general banking info. This is the "first-of-its-kind talking AI bot" the bank highlighted in its 2025 results. [none]

Microsoft Copilot Studio agents for the bank's CRM/customer-service operations: an autonomous email-reading agent that understands intent and acts against the CRM (opening cases, updating customers), plus Quality-Assessment, Case-Management and Customer-Knowledge-Management agents. Shown as hands-on live demos with the bank's CRM teams; evaluation/POC stage rather than confirmed production. [Microsoft (Copilot Studio, Dataverse)]

Bridgewise full-suite deployment for investment advisory: "EquityWise" AI equity-analysis tool for all retail clients and "Bridget" AI chat delivering compliant personalized buy/sell recommendations to VIP clients; expanded the bank's advisory equity coverage using AI-driven analysis. [Bridgewise]
deployments_detail.value: 4.5x advisory coverage expansion (200 to 900+ stocks); 50% of retail clients adopted in first week; avg 3.2 questions per Bridget session
